//1: Repository scripts live in scripts/ (@shotkit/scripts, its own pnpm
//2: project with its own lockfile) and are run through the scripts below,
//3: e.g. `pnpm build:engine --target shot_c`. Run `pnpm -C scripts install`
//4: once per checkout. There is deliberately no pnpm-workspace.yaml here yet:
//5: one at the root makes `pnpm install` inside shotium/ and apps/benchmark
//6: install the workspace instead of that project, and both are installed
//7: standalone by CI. The path to a real workspace is in
//9: This file also keeps the TypeScript compiler from walking above the
//10: repository root when resolving package.json files, and makes it emit
//11: ES modules under the default module="NodeNext" configuration in
name: shotium-repo

scripts.docs: pnpm run docs:assets && pnpm run docs:demo
